numeral-display.purpose: Chamber seat tallies in party color.

legend-head.purpose: Section heads, uppercase with a tick ruler beneath.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system is flat; depth is tint, hairline and frame. Inset 1px rings only draw pill outlines.

motion.name: seat-sweep
motion.value: 900ms linear, paper band 48px wide, peak alpha 0.55
motion.purpose: Runs across a seat bar only when a race is called. Disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Jump links; off under reduced motion.

components.name: Seat Scale Bar
components.description: The signature: seats as a scale bar with ticks, hatched leading seats, and a majority benchmark.
components.css: .ds-bar { position: relative; height: 50px; padding-top: 8px; } .ds-bar-track { display: flex; height: 30px; background: var(--raised, #fffcf5); border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #2f261b); } .ds-bar-track i { display: block; } .ds-d { width: 40%; background: #2f6d9e; } .ds-dl { width: 8%; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #8fb3cf 0 5px, #fffcf5 5px 6.5px); } .ds-rl { margin-left: auto; width: 6%; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #dda59f 0 5px, #fffcf5 5px 6.5px); } .ds-r { width: 30%; background: #b8483e; } .ds-bench { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; bottom: 4px; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; background: var(--ink, #2f261b); }

components.name: Legend Head
components.description: Section heading: ink rule above, uppercase narrow face, tick ruler beneath.
components.css: .ds-sec { border-top: 2px solid #2f261b; padding-block: 24px; } .ds-head { margin: 0; font: 700 1.45rem/1.2 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2f261b; } .ds-head::after { content: ''; display: block; width: 120px; height: 7px; margin-top: 6px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #2f261b; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #2f261b 0 1.5px, transparent 1.5px 12px); }

components.name: Chamber Tally
components.description: Large narrow numerals in party color with a small caption.
components.css: .ds-tally { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-tally b { font: 700 4.5rem/.9 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; color: #2f6d9e; } .ds-tally small { font: 400 .9rem/1.2 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5a4d3c; }

components.name: Sheet Table
components.description: Races table in a raised, contour-framed block with uppercase narrow column heads.
components.css: .ds-scroll { background: #fffcf5; border: 1px solid #9a7b56; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 .93rem 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2f261b; } .ds-table th { text-align: left; padding: 6px 8px; font: 500 .78rem 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5a4d3c; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #2f261b; } .ds-table td { padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4dacb; } .ds-table tr:hover td { background: #fffcf5; } .ds-rate { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .78rem; background: #dcc58e; color: #2f261b; }

components.name: Filter Field
components.description: Select or text input on raised paper with a contour border.
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: 2px; font: 400 .8rem 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5a4d3c; } .ds-field { min-height: 40px; padding: 7px 8px; font: 400 1rem 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2f261b; background: #fffcf5; border: 1px solid #9a7b56; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a4530f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Show More Button
components.description: Single secondary action, paper with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-more { font: 500 1rem 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2f261b; background: #fffcf5; border: 1px solid #e4dacb; border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 18px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-more:hover { border-color: #9a7b56; } .ds-more:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a4530f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Party Tile
components.description: Small square party initial beside a candidate name.
components.css: .ds-pty { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 1.45em; height: 1.45em; border-radius: 3px; background: #2f6d9e; color: #fff; font: 700 .78rem 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Timeline Wave
components.description: Poll-close wave on a dashed trail with a triangle waypoint.
components.css: .ds-tl { position: relative; padding-left: 26px; } .ds-tl::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 9px; top: 6px; bottom: 6px; border-left: 3px dashed #9a7b56; } .ds-wave { position: relative; } .ds-wave::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -22px; top: 5px; width: 14px; height: 13px; background: #9a7b56; clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-wave p { margin: 0; font: 700 1.5rem/1.2 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; color: #2f261b; }

components.name: Upset Ring
components.description: Pencil ellipse drawn around an upset race name.
components.css: .ds-ring { position: relative; display: inline-block; min-width: 104px; text-align: center; padding: 2px 10px; font: 700 1rem 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2f261b; } .ds-ring svg { position: absolute; inset: -6px -8px; width: calc(100% + 16px); height: calc(100% + 12px); overflow: visible; } .ds-ring path { fill: none; stroke: #a4530f; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }

narrative.overview:
The page is a results sheet drawn like a topographic quad: linen paper, brown ink, a muted slate blue and brick red for the two parties. Counts are read off scale bars the way distance is read off a map's scale, not off KPI cards. Every section opens on a heavy ruler rule and a legend-style heading with a short tick ruler under it. Dark mode is Walnut, the same sheet by lamplight, with the same hues lifted for contrast.

The density is that of a newspaper results table: hairline rules between rows, no card chrome, no ambient decoration. There are no background contour lines and no map; the survey language lives only in functional marks (scale bar, benchmark, ruler rules, dashed trail, pencil ring). The palette is brown and cream rather than green; the outdoorsy-map look and the KPI-card dashboard are both refused.

The only motion is the sweep across a seat bar when a race is called, so movement means news. Scroll is smooth unless reduced motion is requested.
keyCharacteristics: Linen ground, brown ink, two party hues and one pencil-orange for human marks.
Archivo Narrow for numerals and legend heads; Source Sans 3 for all running text.
Seat scale bar with a majority benchmark as the signature.
Flat: depth from rules and a raised-paper tint, never shadows.
Square-ish corners (3px) everywhere except rating pills.

rules.name: The Party Hue Rule
rules.body: Blue and red mean Democrat and Republican and nothing else; heather means Independent. Status, emphasis and annotation use ink or pencil.

rules.name: The Pencil Rule
rules.body: Pencil orange marks only what a person would mark by hand on a printed sheet: focus, now, upset, watch-list bell. It never fills a surface.

rules.name: The No-Color-Alone Rule
rules.body: Leading versus won is carried by hatching as well as tint, and ratings by label text as well as chip color.

rules.name: The Numerals Rule
rules.body: Counts, times and tallies set in Archivo Narrow; anything read as a sentence sets in Source Sans 3. Tabular figures in tables and market readouts.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: A surface is distinguished by tint, rule or frame, never by a drop shadow.

dos: Do show counts over a seat scale bar with the majority benchmark, not in a card.
Do open each section with a 2px ink rule and an uppercase Archivo Narrow legend head with the 120px tick ruler.
Do keep blue and red for party, pencil for hand marks, and carry leading versus won by hatching.
Do separate surfaces with tint, hairline or frame; set the page in both Linen and Walnut with the same token names.
Do animate only a sweep on a real call, and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't use KPI cards, tinted stat tiles, or shadows to build hierarchy.
Don't return to green, outdoorsy map costume, background contour lines, or a state map.
Don't use party hues for non-party status, or color alone to separate leading from won.
Don't use Archivo Narrow for running sentences or Source Sans 3 for tallies.
